title: Reply templates
description: Reusable email templates for artist communication. Review each draft before sending. Saving a decision never sends an email.

macros.label: Application received
macros.subject: Your application has been received · Artanrecords
macros.body:
Hello {{name}},

Thank you for sharing your work with Artanrecords. Your application for {{artist}} has been received and is awaiting review.

We aim to respond within 14 working days. This is a review target, not a guaranteed deadline. We will contact you if we need more information.

Submission reference: {{reference}}

Thank you,
Artanrecords

macros.label: Under review
macros.subject: Your submission to Artanrecords · {{artist}}
macros.body:
Hello {{name}},

Thank you for sharing {{artist}} with Artanrecords. Your submission is under review. We aim to respond within 14 working days of submission; this is a review target, not a guaranteed deadline.

We will contact you if we need more information. No partnership or release has been approved at this stage.

macros.label: Propose partnership
macros.subject: A conversation about {{artist}} · Artanrecords
macros.body:
Hello {{name}},

Thank you for sharing your work. We would like to discuss a {{tier}} partnership for {{artist}}.

This is a proposal for discussion, not a final agreement or confirmation of a release. Scope, responsibilities and financial terms must be reviewed and agreed in writing before work begins.

Please reply to discuss the next steps.

Submission reference: {{reference}}

Artanrecords

macros.label: Decline
macros.subject: Your submission to Artanrecords · {{artist}}
macros.body:
Hello {{name}},

Thank you for sharing {{artist}} with us and giving us the opportunity to listen. After reviewing this submission, we are not able to offer a partnership for this project.

We appreciate the time and care you put into your work and wish you well with its next steps.

Submission reference: {{reference}}

Artanrecords

macros.label: Close
macros.subject: Your submission to Artanrecords · {{artist}}
macros.body:
Hello {{name}},

We are writing to let you know that this submission for {{artist}} has been closed. If you believe we have missed relevant information, please reply with the reference below so we can check.

Closing this submission does not establish or change a signed agreement.

Submission reference: {{reference}}

Artanrecords
